title: Wheel scroll steps one line a notch
body:
The mouse wheel used to scroll the pane three lines a notch, which skipped past short outputs. One line a notch now, and the trackpad's fine-grained events coalesce into the same step.

Merged; the checkout under this row is the one to archive next.

comments.body: Tried it on a Magic Trackpad — smooth. One question inline.
